meta.title: Innovation Cluster · Puebla
meta.description: The innovation layer of Puebla's technology ecosystem. We connect startups, talent, infrastructure and investment around the real challenges of industry.

eventBanner.logoAlt: Mexico's Industry Supply Chain — Centro Expositor Puebla, August 12–13, 2026

hero.subtitle: We connect startups, talent, infrastructure and investment around the real challenges of industry.

positioning.text: The other clusters in Puebla are industries. We are the layer that connects them with the technology, the talent and the startups that modernize them.

gap.title: A supplier directory connects what already exists. We build what's missing.

supplier.title: If you're a supplier and you fail the audit
supplier.body: You have the machine and the craft, but they ask you for traceability, documented quality control, response times or certifications you can't sustain today. It isn't a production problem: it's a systems problem. That can be built, and faster than you think.

buyer.title: If you're a buyer and you can't find anyone
buyer.body: The requirement has no domestic supplier, or the process you want to solve is internal and no directory covers it. That isn't a search: it's a build. With startups, technical talent and prototyping infrastructure.

routes.title: Four ways in
routes.subtitle: Find yours and leave us your details. We'll get in touch based on what you're looking for.

industry.title: Industry, suppliers and corporates
industry.intro: You have a digitalization, automation, quality or traceability challenge. We connect you with the startups and the talent that build it.
items: Open Innovation: post your challenge and receive proposals from startups and teams in the ecosystem.
Trained technical talent, available for your projects.
Corporate Venture: invest in the solutions that solve your own challenges.

startup.title: Startups and founders
startup.intro: Incubation, infrastructure and investment to build and scale your technology company.
items: Innovation Hub at CERHAN II: coworking, FabLab and an AI lab with GPUs.
Matchmaking with your complementary partner and with first customers from industry.
Access to investment: the cluster fund, family offices, venture capital and open calls.

investor.title: Investors
investor.intro: Curated dealflow of Puebla startups supported from incubation onward.
items: Startups filtered and validated by the ecosystem.
Co-investment with the cluster fund and other vehicles.
Pitch Days and direct access to founders.

academia.title: Universities and research centers
academia.intro: We connect your talent and research with real demand from industry.
items: Community service, internships and a job board wired into the ecosystem.
Technology transfer to take your research to market.
A Nodes model to extend the ecosystem to your institution.

model.title: How the model works
model.body: Industry brings a real problem. The ecosystem supplies the talent and the startups that solve it. The solution gets built, validated and scaled with access to investment. The result goes back to industry and modernizes it.

infrastructure.title: Real infrastructure
infrastructure.body: The Innovation Hub operates in CERHAN II (Sanctorum), the same complex that hosts Google's and NVIDIA's AI labs.

model.title: A 7-level ecosystem model
model.body: From local industry to strategic direction, with triple-helix governance.

institutional.title: Institutional backing
institutional.body: We work with SECIHTI, SEDETRA, CERHAN and the state's business chambers.

recognition.title: Strategic cluster of Puebla
recognition.body: Recognized within the Industrial Clusters Pavilion.

ai.title: AI lab with GPUs
ai.body: Compute for model development and training.

labs.title: Specialized laboratories
labs.body: Textiles and biomaterials, water treatment, physicochemical analysis, among others.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.body: Extensions of the ecosystem across the state.

closing.body: Write it down. That's all we need to start finding you startups, talent and infrastructure.
